title: Pumpkin Fox
description: This resource pack adds a gorgeous pumpkin head to the foxes, with adorable ears and noses peeking out from it. With Fresh Animations
body:
**Have you ever seen a fox with a pumpkin on his head? No?**
Then this resource pack is for you!

**THIS RESOURCE PACK ONLY CHANGE THE FOX, THE LEAVES AND GRASS ARE CHANGE BY ANOTHER!!!**

Resource pack can be used without Fresh Animations. **Resource pack needs to be made higher than Fresh Animations!!!**

This resource pack has animations from Fresh Animations. Link to [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)
